query: db.patients.aggregate([ { $graphLookup: { from: "patients", startWith: "$name", connectFromField: "name", connectToField: "_id", as: "chain", maxDepth: 0 } }, { $project: { _id: 0, name: 1, chain_depth: { $size: "$chain" } } }, { $sort: { chain_depth: -1 } }])

db.patients.aggregate([ { $lookup: { from: "patients", startWith: "$name", connectFromField: "name", connectToField: "_id", as: "chain", maxDepth: 3 } }, { $project: { _id: 0, name: 1, chain_depth: { $size: "$chain" } } }, { $sort: { chain_depth: -1 } }])
